scope: P-192 depth-3 auxiliary-fiber source, degree-5 endpoint, and identity-wire local component screens on one planted and one seeded-negative query
statement: The prospectively ordered four-block source versus mapped5 confirmation completed 16 of 16 runs with matching SAT and exact point truth; mapped5 had lower wall time in seven of eight pairs, failing the preregistered all-pairs criterion. In a separate exploratory identity-wire control with equal variable and equation counts, identity was faster than mapped5 on both queries.
